content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR)
New Chemistry Unit (NCU), International Centre for Materials Science (ICMS) & School of Advanced Materials (SAMat)
Research Associate or Research Associate (Provisional) – temporary position
Rs. 46,800 p.m. (Provisional) or Rs. 58,000, 61,000 or 67,000 p.m., plus applicable HRA

content_sections.heading: About JNCASR Research Associate
content_sections.text: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research, Jakkur P.O., Bengaluru - 560064, Karnataka, is an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and an Institution Deemed-to-be-University. The Research Associate will work under Dr. Pratap Vishnoi, Assistant Professor, whose Inorganic & Hybrid Materials Group describes its ongoing research at https://www.jncasr.ac.in/faculty/pvishnoi .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Ph.D. in chemistry, materials chemistry, or physics with at least one research paper published in a Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal. Candidates who have submitted their thesis but have not defended it can apply for Research Associate (Provisional). Knowledge of materials synthesis, X-ray crystallography, perovskite synthesis, perovskite structures, magnetic data measurements and analysis. The maximum age limit is 35 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: For the Research Associate level, the remuneration will be fixed based on experience. HRA is paid as applicable on top of the remuneration. The notice describes the position as temporary; the length of the appointment is not specified in the notice.

rows.pay: Rs. 58,000, 61,000, or 67,000 p.m. plus applicable HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR Research Associate
content_sections.text: Fill in the Application form in Template, which the notice says is available on the website. Attach copies of original testimonials in support of educational qualification, age, experience and publications. Attach a brief resume. Send the application to Dr. Pratap Vishnoi at [email protected] latest by 12 November 2026. Duly filled in Application form in Template Copies of original testimonials for educational qualification, age, experience and publications Brief resume No Objection Certificate from the employer – only for candidates who are in employment and are outside candidates

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview. A selection committee will select candidates based on their performance in the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JNCASR Recruitment 2026 for Research Associate?
faq.answer: There is 1 temporary Research Associate position under Advt. No. NCU-Centre-181.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed to [email protected] latest by 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for JNCASR Research Associate?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in chemistry, materials chemistry, or physics with at least one research paper published in a Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of JNCASR Research Associate?
faq.answer: Research Associate (Provisional) gets Rs. 46,800 p.m., and Research Associate gets Rs. 58,000, 61,000, or 67,000 p.m., fixed based on experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the JNCASR Research Associate pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the remuneration is plus applicable HRA for both Research Associate (Provisional) and Research Associate.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Send the duly filled Application form in Template, copies of testimonials for qualification, age, experience and publications, and a brief resume to Dr. Pratap Vishnoi at [email protected] by 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JNCASR Research Associate?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview, and a selection committee will select candidates based on their interview performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their thesis but have not defended it can apply for Research Associate (Provisional) at Rs. 46,800 p.m. plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q10. Is the JNCASR Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the notice describes it as a temporary position.
